content: The redaction-control rule treats an out-of-vocabulary redaction value as if no control were declared, so a policy that requires audit or minimization and declares a malformed redaction reports only the vocabulary violation. Triaged as non-material: the document already fails closed with the stronger schema violation, one offending value deliberately yields one complaint rather than two, and the suppression is pinned by a focused test so the behaviour cannot drift silently.

DOMAIN_PUBLIC_VISIBILITY_OF_CLASSIFIED_DATA only fires when the policy governs data whose classification requires a handling policy, so a policy that declares public visibility while governing nothing is accepted. Triaged as non-material: a policy that governs no classified data exposes nothing, the classification layer owns exposure, and the accepted case is pinned by a focused test so the boundary of the rule is explicit rather than accidental.
